spans.s:
छम् छम्, cl. 1. P. छमति, &c., to eat;
[cf. चम्, जम्, झम्.]

छमच्छमिकारत्न छमच्छमिका-रत्न, अस्,
m., N. of a poet.

छमच्छमित छमच्छमित, अम्, n. (an ono-
matopoetic word with the termination of the past
pass. part.), crackling, rattling.

छमण्ड छमण्ड, अस्, m. an orphan, a
fatherless son; a single man, one who has no kins-
men; [cf. छेमण्ड.]

छम्प् छम्प्, cl. 1. 10. P. छम्पति,
छम्पयति, &c., to go, move.

छम्बट् छम्बट्, ind., Ved. (used with rt.
कृ, especially in sacrificial language), to make a
failure, fail in obtaining or accomplishing.
